title: peace, be still

verses.text: Then Jesus got up and rebuked the wind and the sea. “Silence!” He commanded. “Be still!” And the wind died down, and it was perfectly calm.

caption:
The storm did not settle on its own. He spoke to it.

Whatever is loud in your life right now, it still answers to His voice. He was not absent in the back of the boat, and He was not worried. The calm came because He spoke, not because the wind finally wore itself out.

Mark 4:39 (BSB)

Save this for the day the wind picks up.
